history.summary: A 1,518 sqft 99-yr-leasehold 4BR at CDL's The Myst (TOP ~2029, D23) for $2.89M / $1,904 PSF, 420m from Cashew MRT (Downtown Line). It is a 408-unit launch by a reputable developer at a reasonable PSF (below the $2,041 area median), but a $2.89M leasehold 4BR in OCR sits at the top of D23's price ceiling, thinning the exit pool.
history.rating_rationale: Positives: CDL build quality, 408 units (liquid for OCR), 420m to DT2 Cashew on the Downtown Line, and $1,904 PSF is below the $2,041 median (web confirms project entry ~$1,862 PSF). Negatives: at $2.89M this 4BR is at the upper end of what D23 OCR buyers pay — a narrow resale pool above ~$2.5M out here — and the new-launch bias flag plus uncrystallized 2029 completion mean limited near-term appreciation. Fair launch, full quantum.
red_flags: $2.89M leasehold 4BR is at D23's price ceiling — shallow OCR exit pool above $2.5M
New-launch pricing (bias flagged) — limited immediate appreciation headroom
TOP ~2029 — capital tied up pre-completion, no rental income until then
catalysts: 420m to DT2 Cashew MRT (Downtown Line) — strong transit
CDL developer + 408 units — credible build, OCR-liquid scale
Below area median PSF; Sungei Kadut/DTL extension mid-2030s upside
